After: the pasta is all gone apart from some sauce residue, so roughly 180 g eaten, ~270 kcal. The salad is all eaten: 100 g, 60 kcal. Of the vegetables, about 50 g of corn remains, so about 80 g eaten, ~45 kcal. About half the meat remains, so roughly 130 g eaten, ~330 kcal, which includes the chicken skin.

Total eaten is about 490 g and 705 kcal.
